items.title: Solex chairman cites ~262 GW module vs ~37 GW cell capacity, seeks ALMM-II extension
items.text: Solex Energy's chairman put India's module capacity at about 262 GW against about 37 GW of cell capacity as of October 2026, and asked for ALMM-II to be extended by at least 12 months. Much of the capacity is older MONO PERC and some is non-operational, so the figures are nominal. A deferral would slow the module build-out that drives demand for localised BOM inputs.

sources.title: Solar Manufacturing Capacity Gap Puts India's Green Push to Test

items.title: Avaada Electro gets 7.117 GW TOPCon cell enlistment under ALMM List-II
items.text: MNRE's 13th revision of ALMM List-II enlisted 7.117 GW of N-type TOPCon cell capacity for Avaada Electro's Butibori, Maharashtra plant (enlistment dated 28 Oct 2026). More domestic cell supply eases the ALMM-II constraint on module makers, which underpins demand for localised frames, glass and encapsulant, though cell capacity remains far below module capacity.

sources.title: Avaada Electro Secures 7.117 GW ALMM Enlistment For ToPCon Solar Cell Manufacturing

items.title: Borosil Renewables hit with customs order over solar glass plant machinery classification
items.text: An Additional Commissioner of Customs order dated 15 Oct 2026 rejected the tariff classification Borosil Renewables used for imported solar glass plant and machinery. Goods valued at Rs 14,14,43,335 were confiscated, with redemption on a Rs 30,00,000 fine, plus penalties of Rs 30,000 and Rs 30,00,000 (about Rs 60.3 lakh in total by the article's figures). The company says it will pay under protest, appeal to the Commissioner of Customs (Appeals), and expects no material effect on operations. The amount is small, but the order relates to the machinery for its 1,000 to 1,600 TPD glass expansion.
